ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms authoritative sources, a comparison schedule and the silent-drift flag are declared; it does not compare live settings.
offer: Name the configuration authority and compare observed settings on a defined schedule. Drift must become a visible finding instead of silently redefining the desired state.

minimal.reason: Name the configuration authority each setting is compared to. Without one, drift has no reference, so list the source of truth.

mid.reason: Declare how often observed settings are compared. Unscheduled comparison finds drift late, so set a cadence.

maximal.reason: Set accepting drift silently to false. Drift must become a visible finding rather than redefine the desired state, so report it.
